# Sadhu Vaswani International School (SVIS), Bangalore

> Sadhu Vaswani International School (SVIS) Bangalore is a CBSE-affiliated, co-educational K-12 school in Bettahalasur, Yelahanka, North Bangalore (Karnataka, India). It opened in June 2021 on a 5-acre IGBC Platinum-certified green campus and is part of the Sadhu Vaswani Mission's Mira Movement in Education. Motto: "Simplicity and Service; Purity and Prayer."

## School facts

- **Full name:** Sadhu Vaswani International School, Bangalore (SVIS Bangalore)
- **Opened:** June 2021 (Grades 6–7 added in AY 2023–24; growing toward full K-12 span)
- **Board:** CBSE, New Delhi (Grades I–X)
- **Address:** No 348/1 & 348/2, Bettahalsur Village, Jala Hobli, Yelahanka, Bangalore – 562157, Karnataka, India
- **Nearby landmark:** Padukone–Dravid Centre for Sports Excellence
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 99454 48830
- **Email:** info@svisbangalore.com · enquiries@svisbangalore.com
- **Office hours:** Mon–Fri 8:00 AM–3:30 PM; 2nd & 4th Saturdays 8:00 AM–12:00 Noon
- **School timings:** Mon–Fri — Kindergarten & Nursery 8:00 AM–12:00 Noon; Grade I–X 8:00 AM–3:00 PM
- **Campus:** 5 acres, IGBC Platinum Certified Green School; rainwater harvesting, low-flow fixtures, meatless-day sustainability programme
- **Teacher–student ratio:** 15:1 in Pre-Primary; ~28 students per class in Primary/Secondary
- **Languages:** English medium; Hindi and Kannada offered as second/third languages (Kannada mandatory per NEP)
- **Textbooks, notebooks & uniforms:** provided by / purchased through the school
- **Transport:** GPS-enabled buses (Roorides App) with trained drivers and a female attendant on every route
- **Meals:** optional breakfast (8:30 AM) and lunch (12:00 PM) plan, curated with Team Rujuta Diwekar
- **Safety:** CCTV, lady guards, controlled entry/exit, strict child protection norms, infirmary with qualified nurse
- **Founded by:** Sanjay Wadhwa (Founder Chairman) and Nain Wadhwa; guided by trustees of the Sadhu Vaswani Mission
- **Inspiration:** Sadhu T.L. Vaswani (1879–1966) and Dada J.P. Vaswani (1918–2018)

## Programmes

- **Early Years / Montessori (Nursery–KG II, ages 3–6):** Montessori-inspired sensorial learning, early literacy and numeracy, creative play, motor development. Minimum age as on 31 May of the academic year: Nursery 3 yrs, LKG 4 yrs, UKG 5 yrs, Class 1 6 yrs.
- **Primary (Grades 1–5):** CBSE-aligned 5E / inquiry-based learning; English, Math, Science, Social Studies, Languages, Art, Computer Studies; robotics and digital literacy.
- **Middle School (Grades 6–8):** science labs, Olympiad-oriented mathematics, coding, design thinking.
- **Secondary (Grades 9–10):** CBSE board exam preparation, career guidance, AI integration, competency-based assessments.

## Admissions 2026–27

- Open: Montessori to Grade 8; admissions open each November for the following academic year; mid-year admissions case-by-case subject to seats.
- Process: register → admission-team call → on-campus assessment → parent interaction → admission confirmation email within 5 working days (confirm seat within 7 days).
- Assessment: verbal interaction for KG/Grade I; short written test (English, Math, Science + second language) for Grades II–IX.
- Documents: birth certificate, Aadhaar cards (child + parents), photos, and from Grade 2 the Transfer Certificate and previous report card.

## Facilities

Smart classrooms; Physics, Chemistry and Biology labs per CBSE guidelines; two ICT computer labs; Junior Science & Math Activity Centre; composite lab; naturally lit library; Montessori Learning Center; Resource Center for special education; sanctuary room; yoga and dance studio; amphitheatre seating 650+; arts and music rooms; infirmary; sports field (basketball, football, cricket, skating) with automatic access to the Padukone–Dravid Centre for Sports Excellence; pre-primary play area; cafeteria; daycare for pre-primary.
